summary: A first-party local ATR/BPN land office and official BHUMI parcel viewer were verified. The current viewer identifies the registered-parcel layer and an authenticated parcel retrieval path, but no anonymous safe ID-plus-geometry response was verified; no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime readiness remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Indonesian discovery queries are recorded in city-3875-dumai.json. Results identified the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Dumai, BHUMI/ATLAS, the Dumai land/spatial-planning department and SIDATIN.
requestOutcomes: The local ATR/BPN office page and BHUMI map page were reachable. BHUMI client JavaScript exposed the `umum:Persil` Geoserver layer at `/bhumigs/umum` and an `/expapi/getPersil` retrieval path, but the bounded anonymous WMS/WFS capability requests returned the BHUMI 404 page. The retrieval path was not called because the current client requires authentication and this research does not log in or use credentials. Direct municipal planning and data portal requests returned Cloudflare challenges, which were not bypassed.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [1.67010993042853, 101.445321964373] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift and no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No anonymous parcel geometry, stable native parcel identifier, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
Local cadastral custody is evidenced, but it is not proof of anonymous open vector parcel access or citywide coverage.
A 404 route, authentication wall, Cloudflare challenge, map extent miss or timeout is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
